gender_disparity.interpretation: Statistically significant: Females utilize healthcare significantly more often than males (p < 0.001).

insurance_program_effect.interpretation: Statistically significant: Consultation frequency differs significantly across insurance types (p < 0.001), with Repatriation/Veteran recipients having the highest average utilization.

chronic_condition_effect.interpretation: Statistically significant: Patients with activity-limiting chronic illnesses visit doctors over 2.3x more frequently than those without.
